commits.message:
feat: report each function's cost as a share of network resource limits

Add cargo-budget-report workspace member that displays function resource
costs as a percentage of Soroban's per-transaction network resource limits
(instructions, read bytes, write bytes), alongside the raw values.

Key changes:
- New cargo-budget-report crate with --format text|json output
- Each report row includes share_of_limit_pct (value as % of the network
  limit for that metric)
- Limits are fetched from the Soroban testnet RPC when available; if
  unreachable, hardcoded Protocol 22 limits are used (clearly documented)
- --threshold flag marks functions exceeding the configured share with ⚠
  flag and a warning summary on stderr
- JSON output includes limits, limit_source, threshold_pct, and per-function
  share percentages so consumers can apply their own thresholds
- README.md explains percentage meaning and limit provenance

Closes #131
